I am 45 and I have farmed since I was a boy; I went to school for some years so I can read the fertilizer bag, but I still follow what my father taught me. This plot is only 0.27 hectares, but since I own it, I will buy one bag of NPK 20-10-10 and put about two-thirds on this maize plot, which gives roughly 25 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare. I will also spread manure from my cows, plant my own saved seed, and weed by hand with my family because chemicals cost too much for such a small piece. We depend on the rains here, so I expect my family to spend about 15 days on this plot and hire maybe three extra days when the weeding is heavy.
